feature.name: Improved Critical
feature.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

feature.name: Remarkable Athlete
feature.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature.name: Heroic Warrior
feature.description: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

effects.note: Sem Heroic Inspiration, pode se dar Heroic Inspiration.

feature.name: Superior Critical
feature.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.

feature.name: Survivor
feature.description: Defy Death. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Moreover, when you roll 18-20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it. Heroic Rally. At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

feature.name: Evocation Savant
feature.description: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free. In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

feature.name: Potent Cantrip
feature.description: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on a saving throw against the cantrip, the target takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

feature.name: Sculpt Spells
feature.description: When you cast an Evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

feature.name: Empowered Evocation
feature.description: Whenever you cast a Wizard spell from the Evocation school, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

feature.name: Overchannel
feature.description: When you cast a Wizard spell with a spell slot of levels 1-5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it. The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a Long Rest, you take 2d12 Necrotic damage for each level of the spell slot immediately after you cast it. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. Each time you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, the Necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12.

feature.name: Frenzy
feature.description: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used for the attack.

effects.name: Frenzy
effects.note: Só com Reckless Attack e a Rage ativa, no primeiro alvo do seu turno.

feature.name: Mindless Rage
feature.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

feature.name: Retaliation
feature.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

feature.name: Intimidating Presence
feature.description: As a Bonus Action, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

feature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
feature.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

feature.name: Cutting Words
feature.description: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

feature.name: Magical Discoveries
feature.description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists. Each must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots. You always have the chosen spells prepared, and whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of them with another spell that meets these requirements.

feature.name: Peerless Skill
feature.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.

feature.name: Disciple of Life
feature.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

feature.name: Life Domain Spells
feature.description: When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared: level 3 Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration; level 5 Mass Healing Word, Revivify; level 7 Aura of Life, Death Ward; level 9 Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds.

feature.name: Preserve Life
feature.description: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level, divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you). This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

feature.name: Blessed Healer
feature.description: Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

feature.name: Supreme Healing
feature.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die.

feature.name: Circle of the Land Spells
feature.description: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. You have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared. (Changing the land type is done by editing this choice.)

feature.name: Land's Aid
feature.description: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points. The damage and healing increase by 1d6 at Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

feature.name: Natural Recovery
feature.description: You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, once per Long Rest. In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), none of level 6+; once per Long Rest.

feature.name: Nature's Ward
feature.description: You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice: Arid (Fire), Polar (Cold), Temperate (Lightning), Tropical (Poison).

feature.name: Nature's Sanctuary
feature.description: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself for 1 minute. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there. As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet.

feature.name: Open Hand Technique
feature.description: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target: Addle (it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn), Push (it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you), or Topple (it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition).

feature.name: Wholeness of Body
feature.description: As a Bonus Action, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feature.name: Fleet Step
feature.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

feature.name: Quivering Palm
feature.description: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one attack to end them; the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. Only one creature can be under this effect at a time.

feature.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
feature.description: When you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared: level 3 Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith; level 5 Aid, Zone of Truth; level 9 Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic; level 13 Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith; level 17 Commune, Flame Strike.

feature.name: Sacred Weapon
feature.description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage. The weapon also emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond that.

feature.name: Aura of Devotion
feature.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

feature.name: Smite of Protection
feature.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

feature.name: Holy Nimbus
feature.description: As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 minutes or until you end it: you have Advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead; whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, it takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus; and the aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot.

feature.name: Hunter's Lore
feature.description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

feature.name: Hunter's Prey
feature.description: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice; whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace it with the other one.

feature.name: Colossus Slayer
feature.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

feature.name: Horde Breaker
feature.description: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

feature.name: Defensive Tactics
feature.description: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice; whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace it with the other one.

feature.name: Escape the Horde
feature.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

feature.name: Multiattack Defense
feature.description: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

feature.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
feature.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

feature.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
feature.description: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

feature.name: Fast Hands
feature.description: As a Bonus Action, you can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket, or take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

feature.name: Second-Story Work
feature.description: Climber: you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Jumper: you can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

feature.name: Supreme Sneak
feature.description: You gain the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option (cost 1d6): if you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

feature.name: Use Magic Device
feature.description: Attunement: you can attune to up to four magic items at once. Charges: whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6; on a 6, you use the property without expending the charges. Scrolls: you can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability; for a spell of level 2 or higher, you must first succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level), or the scroll disintegrates.

feature.name: Thief's Reflexes
feature.description: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

effects.note: Na primeira rodada do combate, tem dois turnos: o primeiro na sua iniciativa e o segundo na iniciativa − 10.

feature.name: Draconic Resilience
feature.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

feature.name: Draconic Spells
feature.description: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared: level 3 Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; level 5 Fear, Fly; level 7 Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; level 9 Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

feature.name: Elemental Affinity
feature.description: Choose one of these damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

feature.name: Dragon Wings
feature.description: As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back for 1 hour or until you dismiss them, giving you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points to restore your use of it.

feature.name: Dragon Companion
feature.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require Concentration; if you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

feature.name: Dark One's Blessing
feature.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1). You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

feature.name: Fiend Spells
feature.description: When you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared: level 3 Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion; level 5 Fireball, Stinking Cloud; level 7 Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; level 9 Geas, Insect Plague.

feature.name: Dark One's Own Luck
feature.description: When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can add 1d10 to your roll, after seeing the roll but before any of its effects occur. You can do so a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), but no more than once per roll. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feature.name: Fiendish Resilience
feature.description: Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature. (Changing it is done by editing this choice.)

feature.name: Hurl Through Hell
feature.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or disappear through the Lower Planes, taking 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn't a Fiend and having the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a Pact Magic spell slot.
